description: Source code for the BrowserState struct and related functionality, managing browser page state, navigation history, coverage, exceptions, and screenshot handling in a web debugging context.

classes.name: BrowserState
classes.description: Represents the state of a browser page, including URL, title, content type, console entries, navigation history, exceptions, coverage data, transition hash, and screenshot.

classes.name: Coverage
classes.description: Holds information about new coverage edges detected during page analysis.

classes.name: NavigationHistory
classes.description: Tracks the navigation history with back, current, and forward entries.

classes.name: NavigationEntry
classes.description: Represents a single navigation point with id, title, and URL.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Details of an exception encountered during page execution, including stack trace and remote object info.

classes.name: ExceptionRemoteObject
classes.description: Represents a remote object associated with an exception.

classes.name: CallFrame
classes.description: Represents a call frame in a stack trace.

classes.name: ConsoleEntry
classes.description: Represents a console log entry with timestamp, level, and arguments.

classes.name: ConsoleEntryLevel
classes.description: Enumeration for console log levels: Warning or Error.

classes.name: ScreenshotFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for screenshot image formats: Webp, Png, Jpeg.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs a BrowserState instance by evaluating page properties, navigation history, coverage, and transition hash.

methods.name: evaluate_function_call
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates a function call within the debugger context, returning the deserialized output.
